our_interpretation: They refers to OpenAI and Anthropic. The surrounding discussion concerns companies using their model APIs.
Throttling means provider-imposed delays, request rejection or throughput restrictions caused by customer demand exceeding allowed capacity.
The forecast does not require malicious intent, a new pricing tier or a reduction in previously promised limits.
Evidence for both named providers is needed to settle the complete forecast. An individual subscription limit alone does not establish throttling of a business API customer.
Earlier Cursor incidents are historical premises, not fulfillment of the future prediction.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event permanently makes the predicted conduct impossible for a named provider. A temporary absence of reported throttling does not contradict this open-ended forecast.
